verdict.rationale: Anrok's pricing page says filing and payments are "done for you" (anrok-docs-28). The docs show transactions are automatically associated with tax returns, can be voided off a return, and filings can be fetched via API (anrok-docs-6, anrok-docs-35, anrok-docs-12). This covers automated preparation, filing, and remittance only at a marketing-claim level, and the penalty guarantee, a key part of the story, is absent. Missing for 10: any evidence of a vendor guarantee covering late-filing penalties, documented on-time filing commitments or SLAs, explicit coverage of every registered jurisdiction for filing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
